thread:
jordan: Quick intake from support — FinCloud (mid-market) submitted a request for a Console heatmap that correlates per-tenant cost vs p95 latency + trace density. They want filters: model, region, subscription plan, date range. Support ticket: https://rwd.in/t/7890
rahul: They said finance needs monthly exports and ops wants the ability to slice by model. Customer mentioned they'd consider a paid add-on for richer visibility.
elaine: Thanks — can product triage? We should decide MVP scope and launch criteria. This overlaps cost attribution and console dashboards.
marta: Observability note: we already capture per-request token_cost and latency. The heatmap would be aggregated by latency buckets and cost buckets per tenant/model/region. Backend work: add rollups + new materialized view. Rough estimate: 2 infra sprints + 1 UI sprint.
kai: Engineering constraints: current pipeline indexes primarily by time and request_id. Adding tenant+model cardinality increases cardinality x2-4 depending on customer mix. We need rollup cadence and a sampling strategy to keep storage growth in check. Also billing schema needs a minor change to expose token_cost in the rollups.
elaine: Proposal for MVP: aggregated bucketed heatmap tile in Console that shows (latency_bucket vs cost_bucket) with counts and total cost. Filters: model, region, plan, date range. Raw traces not included in MVP — click-to-open goes to trace search. Launch criteria: aggregated cost sums within 5% of billing export, dashboard query latency < 2s for 90th pct, and privacy review sign-off.
rahul: Customer said that sounds fine; they want a canary with 2 tenants and CSV export of the heatmap for finance.
marta: CSV export doable — we'll emit pre-aggregated buckets to analytics.rollups. Example query for rollups: ```SELECT tenant_id, model, latency_bucket, SUM(token_cost) as cost, COUNT(*) as requests FROM telemetry.rollups WHERE ts >= '2026-02-01' GROUP BY 1,2,3;```
kai: Risks: naive rollout can spike ingestion and query costs. Mitigation: sample at the edge, run periodic batch rollups, and cap retention for heatmap buckets. I'll open infra tickets. Estimated engineering work: ~3 dev-weeks + infra runbook.
elaine: Scope decision: add to product backlog under EPIC-OBS-37 (console observability improvements). Tentative priority: P2 for this quarter, P1 if we get >$50k ARR commitment. Need acceptance criteria from support for pilot.
metrics-bot: New ticket created: https://rwd.in/issue/EPIC-OBS-37-heatmap by elaine
jordan: I'll add FinCloud to the pilot list, capture explicit acceptance tests (CSV export, model filter, accuracy vs billing), and share sample datasets. Will follow up with a short kickoff doc.
marta: :thumbsup:
kai: +1
elaine: Thanks everyone — adding to roadmap sync for Tues. Jordan — please drop the pilot criteria in the thread when ready.
